16: export function createExecutionObservationStore(now: () => string = () => new Date().toISOString()): ExecutionObservationStore {
17:   const running = new Map<string, ExecutionObservation>()
18:   const sessions = new Map<string, number>()
19:   const get = (callId: string) => running.get(callId)
20:   const hasRunningSession = (sessionId: string) => (sessions.get(sessionId) ?? 0) > 0
21:   const finish = (callId: string, status: "succeeded" | "failed" | "incomplete", finishedAt: string, result?: ExecutionResultObservation) => {
22:     const attempt = running.get(callId)
23:     if (!attempt) throw new Error(`Unknown execution callID: ${callId}`)
24:     if ((status === "succeeded" || status === "failed") && !result) throw new Error(`${status} execution requires a result`)
25:     running.delete(callId)
26:     const count = (sessions.get(attempt.sessionId) ?? 1) - 1
27:     if (count <= 0) sessions.delete(attempt.sessionId); else sessions.set(attempt.sessionId, count)
28:     return { ...attempt, status, finishedAt, ...(result ? { result } : {}) }
29:   }
30:   return {
31:     start(input) {
32:       if (!input.callId || !input.sessionId || !input.taskId || !input.phase) throw new Error("Execution observation requires callId, sessionId, taskId, and phase")
33:       if (running.has(input.callId)) throw new Error(`Execution callID already running: ${input.callId}`)
34:       const attempt = { ...input, status: "running" as const, startedAt: input.startedAt ?? now() }
35:       running.set(attempt.callId, attempt)
36:       sessions.set(attempt.sessionId, (sessions.get(attempt.sessionId) ?? 0) + 1)
37:       return attempt
38:     },

10: async function callKernelProcess<T>(payload: string, options: KernelTransportOptions, decode: (payload: string) => T, label: string): Promise<T> {
11:   const command = options.command ?? process.env.TONYMEM_PYTHON ?? "python3"
12:   const args = options.args ?? ["-m", "kernel.boundary"]
13:   const timeoutMs = options.timeoutMs ?? 5000
14:   return new Promise((resolve) => {
15:     let settled = false
16:     let stdout = ""
17:     let stderr = ""
18:     const child = spawn(command, args, { cwd: options.cwd, stdio: ["pipe", "pipe", "pipe"] })
19:     const finish = (response: T) => { if (settled) return; settled = true; clearTimeout(timer); resolve(response) }
20:     const timer = setTimeout(() => { child.kill(); finish(fallback<T>(`${label} transport timed out`)) }, timeoutMs)
21:     child.stdout.setEncoding("utf8")
22:     child.stderr.setEncoding("utf8")
23:     child.stdout.on("data", (chunk: string) => { stdout += chunk })
24:     child.stderr.on("data", (chunk: string) => { stderr += chunk })
25:     child.on("error", (error) => finish(fallback<T>(`${label} process unavailable: ${error.message}`)))
26:     child.on("close", (code) => {
27:       if (settled) return
28:       if (code !== 0) return finish(fallback<T>(`${label} process failed${stderr.trim() ? `: ${stderr.trim()}` : ""}`))
29:       try { finish(decode(stdout.trim())) } catch { finish(fallback<T>(`Invalid ${label} response`)) }
30:     })
31:     child.stdin.end(payload)
32:   })
33: }
